answer: Every identity posts a ferrous anchor fused to one funding root: two identities sharing a root fuse their anchors, so one fake slashes both. Each epoch a public delta fans a branching challenge through the attestation graph, and the audited identity must walk one branch with proofs salted to its own address in one block. A haven holds each branch's yield, paying only when the branch is collision-free; clones share sponsors, so their paths collide, and each collision forfeits a share growing with the square of collisions. N clones lose about N squared while one honest agent risks one anchor.
